news.title: Bets on Fed rate cut by year-end grow after Iran truce - Investing.com
news.zh: 伊朗停火後，投資者對美聯儲年底前降息的押注增加
news.impact: 降息預期上升，可能提振股市和債市

news.title: Delta Air Lines Announces March Quarter 2026 Financial Results - Delta
news.zh: 德爾塔航空公司公布2026年3月季度財務成績
news.impact: 航空業財報，反映客運需求和營運狀況

news.title: Broadcom Stock Rises On Google AI Chip Deal - Investor's Business Daily
news.zh: 博通股票因谷歌AI芯片交易協議而上漲
news.impact: 獲得大客戶AI芯片訂單，營收增長動力強

news.title: Super Micro Launches Internal Probe of Server Sales to China - Bloomberg.com
news.zh: 超微計算機公司對服務器對華銷售啟動內部調查
news.impact: 涉及地緣政治風險和監管問題，股價面臨壓力

news.title: 2 years ago, Saudi Arabia quietly canceled the ‘petrodollar’ deal with America that wired the world economy for 50 years. Then war broke out in Iran - Yahoo Finance
news.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯兩年前悄悄終止「石油美元」協議，該協議曾支撐全球經濟50年，隨後中東爆發戰爭
news.impact: 美元地位動搖，全球經濟格局重塑，系統性風險

news.title: New Medicare Payment Rate Released. Why UnitedHealth, Humana Are Popping. - Barron's
news.zh: 新醫療保險支付費率公佈，聯合健康和Humana公司股價上漲

news.title: FDIC Approves Proposal to Implement GENIUS Act Requirements and Standards - Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) (.gov)
news.zh: 聯邦存款保險公司(FDIC)批准實施《天才法案》要求的提案與標準
news.impact: 銀行監管框架更新，影響金融機構合規成本

news.title: FinCEN Proposes Rule to Fundamentally Reform Financial Institution Programs Designed to Fight Illicit Finance - FinCEN.gov
news.zh: FinCEN提議根本改革金融機構反非法融資計劃
news.impact: 金融監管加強，機構合規成本上升

news.title: Major alcohol distributor shuts down operations, lays off over 500 workers

news.title: The economy slowed sharply even before the Iran war. Where does it go from here?
news.zh: 經濟在伊朗戰爭前已大幅放緩，未來走向何方
news.impact: 經濟增長放緩加地緣政治風險，衰退憂

news.title: EU Eases Methane Rules to Keep Oil and Gas Flowing
news.zh: 歐盟放寬甲烷規則以維持石油和天然氣供應

news.title: U.S. LNG Exports Soar To Record Levels In March Amid Panic Buying
news.zh: 美國3月份液化天然氣出口達創紀錄水平，受恐慌性購買驅動
